item.title: Reconfiguring Quinone Cathodes via Transition Metal Coordination for Advanced Calcium Batteries
item.description:
هماهنگی فلزات واسطه Cu و Ni با کینون، چارچوب مولکولی را بازآرایی کرده و کاتدهای کلسیمی با ظرفیت ۲۰۳ mAh g–1 و انرژی بالای ۶۰۰ Wh kg–1 فراهم می‌کند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in molecular engineering of quinone cathodes via transition-metal (Cu, Ni) coordination, reconfiguring the conjugated framework to boost both capacity and voltage. Significance: optimized cathodes reach 203 mAh g–1 at ~3.1 V, exceeding 600 Wh kg–1, with a revealed bipolar Ca2+/TFSI– storage mechanism, offering a promising route to high-energy multivalent calcium batteries.
🏷 calcium-ion batteries · quinone cathodes · metal coordination · bipolar charge storage · energy density

item.title: Domain‐Pinned Ferroelectric‐Like Fields Drive Deep Zn 2+ Intercalation in Bi 2 TeO 5
item.description:
کاتد Cr-doped Bi2TeO5 با میدان‌های فروالکتریک-مانند پین‌شده، سد مهاجرت Zn2+ را به ۰.۳۴ eV کاهش داده و درهم‌آمیزی عمیق و پایدار در باتری آبی روی-یون را ممکن می‌سازد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Cr-doped oxygen-vacancy Bi2TeO5 creates domain-pinned ferroelectric-like fields via Cr/Ov engineering and Bi3+/Te4+ lone pairs, yielding a 77 mV built-in potential and lowering Zn2+ migration barrier from 0.75 to 0.34 eV. This enables reversible deep intercalation (~360 mAh g−1) and 77% capacity retention over 2000 cycles, showing ferroelectric-like fields convert deep Zn2+ intercalation into a sustainable pathway.
🏷 aqueous zinc-ion battery · Bi2TeO5 cathode · ferroelectric-like fields · oxygen vacancies · Zn2+ intercalation

💡 This work introduces a descriptor-based inverse design framework mapping target electrolyte properties to molecular, polymeric, and lattice building blocks, decomposing performance into stability, transport, leakage, safety, and lifecycle.
